The §cG§6a§el§al§bi§9f§dr§ce§6y§ea§an§r Time Dilation Field Generator grants a §299.609375%§r time reduction for any recipe ran in the EoH, but reduces the likelihood of success by §c74%§r.

The §cG§6a§el§al§bi§9f§dr§ce§6y§ea§an§r Stabilisation Field Generator will boost the success chance of the EoH by §240%§r, but will decrease the yield by §c40%§r.

[note]If you want to run a T10 EoH that is power positive, the best setup to use is a T9/T8/T9 (Using Tipler Time Dilation Field Generators).[/note]
